country.name: Perú
country.languagePolicy: Spanish is the default interface language. Indigenous or original languages and Peruvian Sign Language require locally appropriate bilingual, community and institutional review; automatic translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Peruvian reviewer, current authoritative sources and review of the responsible national, regional, local, community, institution or program authority.

governanceModel.summary: Peru combines MINEDU national policy and curriculum with decentralized administration through regional education directorates or management offices and local education management units. ESCALE records educational services, while SUNEDU licensing and program authorization apply to university education under their respective current decisions.
governanceModel.regionalAuthorities: Direcciones o Gerencias Regionales de Educación (DRE/GRE) and Unidades de Gestión Educativa Local (UGEL)
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve the educational-service modular code, institution and premises identifiers where available, level or modality, management type, supervising DRE or UGEL, status, source date and review date.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institutional licensing, authorized premises, authorized programs, degree registration, and separate accreditation or quality claims are distinct and require current evidence.

authorities.name: Ministerio de Educación
authorities.role: national education policy, curriculum and system stewardship

authorities.name: Direcciones o Gerencias Regionales de Educación and UGEL
authorities.role: regional and local education administration, supervision and source data for educational services

authorities.name: Unidad de Estadística Educativa — ESCALE
authorities.role: educational-service registry, census data and education statistics

authorities.name: Superintendencia Nacional de Educación Superior Universitaria
authorities.role: university institutional licensing, authorized programs and university degree registry services

authorities.name: Ministerio de Educación — higher technological, pedagogical and artistic education
authorities.role: licensing and information for non-university higher-education institutions under Law 30512

authorities.name: Autoridad Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales
Ministerio de la Mujer y Poblaciones Vulnerables
authorities.role: national child and adolescent protection policy

curriculum.title: Currículo Nacional de la Educación Básica and current implementation rules
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm level, modality, curricular program, version, current MINEDU rules, regional or local implementation and the institution's instruments before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: External materials may supplement but never silently replace the current national curriculum, regional or local implementation, institutional curriculum, or a community-governed intercultural bilingual curriculum.

schoolDirectory.authority: MINEDU ESCALE with location and service data provided through DRE/GRE and UGEL
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: ESCALE records educational services and programs, not necessarily one-to-one institutions. Location data are provided by DRE/GRE and UGEL, and census cartographic boundaries do not establish political-administrative jurisdiction. A service listing does not prove every current authorization.

educationStatistics.authority: Unidad de Estadística Educativa — ESCALE, MINEDU
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display Censo Educativo reference year, registry update date, measure, population, geography, management type, source and filters. Educational-service counts must not be mislabeled as institution counts.

higherEducation.nonUniversityAuthority: MINEDU under the applicable Law 30512 framework
higherEducation.authorityNotice: University institutional licensing, licensed premises, authorized programs, degree or title registration, and separate accreditation or quality claims are distinct. Non-university higher institutes and schools use a separate MINEDU framework. Each claim must identify the authority, institution or program, resolution, scope, date and current status.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Ley N.º 29733, Ley de Protección de Datos Personales, and current regulations
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Ley N.º 27337, Código de los Niños y Adolescentes, as amended
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Personal-data legal bases, children's best interests, consent or authorization where applicable, safeguarding, incident handling and institutional protocols require qualified Peruvian review before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Education affecting Indigenous or original peoples must preserve their right to culturally and linguistically relevant education and consultation. EIB service, language, teacher and institution status must be verified against current MINEDU rules and community context. BRASA must not treat a policy proposal under prior consultation as enacted policy or substitute automatic translation for community participation.

completionCriteria: A qualified Peruvian education reviewer is named.
MINEDU, DRE/GRE and UGEL responsibilities are reviewed for the participating jurisdiction.
Every educational-service record preserves modular code, institutional and premises identifiers where available, level or modality, management, supervising authority, source date and review date.
Every statistic shows reference year, update date, definition, geography, population and provenance, and service counts are not mislabeled as institution counts.
Every higher-education claim distinguishes university licensing, premises, authorized programs, degree registration, accreditation and the separate non-university framework.
Curriculum mappings identify level, modality, program, version, effective rule, local implementation and institution instruments.
Indigenous or original language and EIB requirements are reviewed with competent community participation.
Current personal-data, child-protection and local safeguarding requirements are reviewed by qualified Peruvian counsel.
Privacy, safeguarding, accessibility, incident and consent procedures are approved by each participating institution.
No authorization, licensing, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
